mapper.sql: e.id, e.account_id, e.platform_type, e.collection_run_id, e.entity_type, e.entity_id, e.entity_key, e.change_type, e.field_name, e.old_value, e.new_value, e.severity, e.message, e.detected_at, e.in_use, e.metadata, g.group_name AS group_name, -- 管理员要看到的是「我自己的哪个 sub2api 账号」+「哪个上游 key」，只给 ID 没法对号入座 COALESCE(NULLIF(a.display_name, ''), a.username) AS account_name, (SELECT k.key_name FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND k.external_key_id = e.entity_key ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_name, g.current_ratio AS group_ratio, -- 受影响的「上游账号 Key」：密钥事件按 key 匹配，渠道事件按同分组匹配 (SELECT string_agg(k.key_name, '、' ORDER BY k.id) FROM account_api_keys k WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND ((e.entity_type = 'API_KEY' AND k.external_key_id = e.entity_key) OR (e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND (g.group_name IS NULL OR k.group_name = g.group_name)))) AS upstream_key_names, -- 对应的「本平台 Key」：号池账号通过 bound_key_id 绑到上游 Key (SELECT string_agg(pa.name, '、' ORDER BY pa.id) FROM account_api_keys k JOIN pool_accounts pa ON pa.bound_key_id = k.id WHERE k.account_id = e.account_id AND ((e.entity_type = 'API_KEY' AND k.external_key_id = e.entity_key) OR (e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND (g.group_name IS NULL OR k.group_name = g.group_name)))) AS local_key_names
FROM upstream_change_events e LEFT JOIN upstream_groups g ON g.account_id = e.account_id AND g.external_group_id = e.entity_key LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = e.account_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upstream_change_events ( account_id, platform_type, collection_run_id, entity_type, entity_id, entity_key, change_type, field_name, old_value, new_value, severity, message, detected_at, in_use, metadata ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{platformType}, #{collectionRunId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{entityKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{oldValue,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{newValue,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{severity}, #{message}, #{detectedAt}, #{inUse}, #{metadata,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE e.in_use = TRUE AND e.entity_type = 'GROUP' AND e.change_type IN ('RATE_CHANGED', 'BASE_RATE_CHANGED') AND e.detected_at >= #{since} ORDER BY e.detected_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
